title: Monster Energy
subtitle: Energy drink brand one-pager
description: Black-and-green one-pager for Monster Energy. A spinning wheel of the real cans with the chosen one up front, a hold-to-crack button that wakes up the claw with lightning and fizz, seven flavours that recolour the whole site, a pinned sideways lineup and generative sport scenes.
conceptNote: Unofficial concept for a real brand. Not affiliated.
